details: Automated scanning of @zannstore/baileys@2.4.1 produced no a static rule matches and no traced installer-harm behaviors across 433 files. No exfiltration endpoints, install/import-time remote code execution, credential-harvest paths, silent-relay mechanisms, backdoor code, or dropper patterns were identified in the package contents. The package name suggests a fork of the WhatsApp Web API library Baileys; forks of that library have historically been used to embed covert auto-follow/subscribe side-effects, but no such behavior was observed in this version's scanned files.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
